selection_rule: Regex match useful_readonly_action for read-only dpkg-query, privileged watchdog attribution, privileged modeset read, or attached backup-device mount identity; exclude Docker OOM and NVMe test-file implementation gaps.

close_check.porque: Aplicar el alcance y los controles concretos de la evidencia copiada arriba: stack/OEM y versiones fijadas, sujeto real, caso sano y negativo, resultados literales y rollback cuando haya intervención. Si faltan hardware, adjuntos, compatibilidad o permisos, imprimir could_not_run y conservar open. Un score agregado o mero estado de un dispositivo no acredita el resultado funcional. No instalar parches ni provocar fallo del host para registrar la ficha.

items.useful_readonly_action: After the intended backup device is attached, read-only findmnt/lsblk/UUID plus current boot_id could bind the actual mount; no target is presently known.
items.prerequisite_or_blocker: Known backup device/expected UUID and boot identity.

close_check.porque: Verificador propuesto pendiente: requiere evidencia del caso positivo, controles negativos, compatibilidad OEM y recuperación/rollback; la ficha registra trabajo abierto.

items.useful_readonly_action: A privileged read-only lsof/fuser attribution of /dev/watchdog0 could reduce owner uncertainty; do not repeat the unprivileged query.
items.prerequisite_or_blocker: Permission for read-only device-owner attribution; OEM recovery policy still required.

close_check.porque: Show that OTA compatibility checks detect a conflicting DRM modeset override before update, with safe recovery and a clean-system negative control.

items.useful_readonly_action: One privileged read-only read of /sys/module/nvidia_drm/parameters/modeset would close that specific observation gap; does not close OTA compatibility.
items.prerequisite_or_blocker: Read permission; OTA target/recovery evidence remains external.

close_check.porque: Demostrar un gate previo al reboot que detecta estado dpkg/DKMS incoherente, ausencia de initrd/módulo para el kernel objetivo y una recuperación arrancable; incluir negativos de kernel sano y rollback.

items.useful_readonly_action: A bounded read-only dpkg-query ownership/version and modinfo path/signature query may resolve current package/module provenance; do not run package operations.
items.prerequisite_or_blocker: Root/read permissions for provenance; update/reboot A/B and recovery remain separately authorized.

close_check.porque: Verificador pendiente: prueba binding PCI efectivo y paquete/módulo compatible; warm/cold reboot A/B y rollback con controles de otra NIC, driver ausente y consulta fallida.

items.useful_readonly_action: Read-only dpkg-query -S plus modinfo -n/version/signature can improve package provenance if available; avoid repeating current PCI/module version inventory.
items.prerequisite_or_blocker: Permission for package/module provenance; reboot/A-B and rollback need approval.
